nodes.summary: A circular edge-covering walk: a nonempty closed walk through every edge.
nodes.title: Circular edge-covering walk

nodes.summary: `w` is a subwalk of the circular walk `A`: it is read off `A` from some start position, wrapping around (possibly several times).
nodes.title: Subwalk of a circular walk

nodes.summary: Safe walks are omnitigs (Theorem 1, (1) ⇒ (2)), when a circular edge-covering walk exists (otherwise every walk is vacuously safe).
nodes.title: Safe walks are omnitigs

nodes.summary: Omnitig (Tomescu–Medvedev, Definition 5): for all `1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ t` (`t + 1 = w.length`), no path from `v_j = src e_j` to `v_i = src e_i` has first edge `≠ e_j` and last edge `≠ e_{i-1}`.
nodes.title: Omnitig

nodes.summary: A path: a nonempty walk whose nodes `src e₀, tgt e₀, …, tgt e_ℓ` are distinct, except that the first and last node may coincide.
nodes.title: Path in a directed multigraph

nodes.summary: Safe walk: a subwalk of every circular edge-covering walk.
nodes.title: Safe walk in a multigraph

nodes.summary: A list of edges is a walk when consecutive edges are incident (head to tail).
nodes.title: Walk in a directed multigraph

nodes.summary: A directed multigraph given by the source and target of each edge.
nodes.title: Directed multigraph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
